name: Yousef Hindi
headline: Full Stack Engineer | React, Node.js, TypeScript, Python | AI-Assisted Development | AWS • Docker • API Integration
shortHeadline: Full-stack engineer building scalable, accessible web platforms
summary: Full-stack engineer in Amman specializing in scalable, secure, and accessible web platforms. I currently work as a Full Stack Engineer at Optimum Partners Global, with a focus on React, testing, and WCAG-compliant UX.

about.title: How I think about engineering
about.body: I care about accessibility, reliability, and shipping work you can verify. At Optimum Partners I raised an accessibility score to 100% against WCAG, and I lean on unit tests, Playwright, and API checks so quality is part of the build, not a pass at the end.

about.title: What I enjoy building
about.body: Responsive web apps and reusable component systems in React and Vue, plus the tests and diagrams that make those systems easy to hand off. I also use AI-assisted workflows (Cursor, Claude, and similar tools) to move faster without skipping fundamentals.

about.title: Outside work
about.body: I perform stand-up with Amman Comedy Club, teach English and improv, and keep a few creative side projects going. That mix of teaching and comedy is how I practice clear communication.

experience.title: Full Stack Engineer
experience.summary: Build responsive, accessible web apps with React, Vue, Tailwind, and Playwright. Improved accessibility to a 100% WCAG score, added reusable components and E2E coverage, and used AI-assisted tooling to speed up delivery while keeping cybersecurity practices in the lifecycle.
